settings.heading: More Than What You Wear
settings.paragraph_one: Kapisa Healthcare was created with a simple purpose: to bring more comfort, confidence, and care to the people who spend their days caring for others.
settings.paragraph_two: We believe healthcare apparel should support the rhythm of real work while still feeling considered and personal. Every detail is thoughtfully designed to move with you, wear beautifully, and make demanding days feel a little easier.
settings.paragraph_three: From first sketch to final stitch, our commitment is to create dependable, thoughtfully made apparel for healthcare professionals who show up with purpose every day.

settings.vision_text: To build a healthier future through trusted, accessible healthcare solutions that help people live with confidence.
settings.mission_text: To deliver thoughtful healthcare products and experiences with integrity, innovation, and care at every step.

settings.description_one: Considered details made for a better everyday experience.
settings.description_two: Comfort-focused essentials that fit naturally into your routine.
settings.description_three: Reliable choices designed to help you feel ready for the day.
settings.description_four: Simple, dependable solutions that work with the way you live.
